title: Multimodal deep learning from spectra for small-molecule structure identification: enhancing robustness with mixed-condition training
abstract: arXiv:2609.14360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In practical molecular characterization, small-molecule structure identification benefits from complementary spectroscopic evidence, but missing, degraded, or mismatched spectra challenge multimodal models. Herein, we incorporate domain knowledge from spectroscopy and chemistry into mixed-condition training for candidate structure reranking, using a reproducible evaluation protocol and mixture-of-experts (MoE) fusion. The protocol incorporates perturbations tailored to each spectroscopic modality and chemically informed spectrum replacements to cover variations in spectral availability, quality, and consistency. A total of 79,462 test samples were evaluated across 30 predefined conditions using simulated spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSSD) for mass spectrometry (MS), infrared (IR) spectroscopy, and 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), with up to 128 hard candidate structures per sample. translated_abstract: 在实际分子表征中，小分子结构鉴定受益于互补的光谱证据，但缺失、退化或不匹配的光谱给多模态模型带来了挑战。本文中，我们将光谱学和化学领域的知识融入混合条件训练中，用于候选结构重排序，并采用可复现的评估协议和专家混合模型融合。该评估协议包含针对每种光谱模态定制的扰动以及基于化学信息的光谱替换，以覆盖光谱可用性、质量和一致性方面的变化。研究使用来自多模态光谱数据集（MSSD）的模拟光谱，针对质谱（MS）、红外（IR）光谱以及1H和13C核磁共振（NMR），在30个预定义条件下共评估了79,462个测试样本，每个样本最多包含128个困难候选结构。一项受控的2×2……
tldr: 该论文提出将光谱学与化学领域知识融入混合条件训练和专家混合融合的候选结构重排序方法，并通过包含模态定制扰动与化学信息光谱替换的可复现评估协议，显著提升了多模态光谱深度学习模型在缺失、退化和不匹配光谱条件下进行小分子结构鉴定的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper incorporates spectroscopy and chemistry domain knowledge into mixed-condition training with mixture-of-experts fusion for candidate structure reranking, using a reproducible evaluation protocol with modality-tailored perturbations and chemically informed spectrum replacements to enhance the robustness of multimodal spectral deep learning for small-molecule structure identification under missing, degraded, and mismatched spectral conditions.
